clips.hook: A freaking Inu did 3 billion with zero centralized exchanges.
clips.caption:
Look at what 2021 actually did. Akita Inu launched February 1st, went down down down to a 120 thousand dollar market cap, and then printed a god candle all the way to 3 billion. No Coinbase. No Binance. No tier 1 listing. Just an Inu and a bull run.

Now put that next to what is coming. The Robinhood chain is going to pull in serious liquidity, and the people holding right now are the early ones. If a token on the Robinhood chain gets listed in the Robinhood app in a parabolic bull run, 10 or 20 billion is not a moon boy number. It is what already happened once without any of those advantages.

Could CashCat and $IF get there? That is the question I keep coming back to.

clips.hook: I put a 20x on $LAB. It did a 350x.
clips.caption:
Sometimes I get scared to give these moon boyish price predictions. Then I look at the receipts and I was not too high. I was way too low.

I put a 20x price prediction on the $LAB token. We bought that at the bottom in December. It did a 350x, and that was just a couple of months back. I gave Velvet something like a 30x. It did a 58x, and I still think it has room to grow from here.

That is the part people miss in a bear market. The calls that sound unrealistic are usually the ones that end up being conservative.

clips.hook: Tendies is exactly the kind of stupid Vlad wants to list.
clips.caption:
The only ones that really float my boat right now are What If, Cooper, and Tendies. I have not even gotten any Tendies yet, and it is still the one I keep coming back to, for one reason: it is stupid.

That is the whole point. It reminds me of the Fartcoin concept. You look at it and think that is ridiculous, and then people buy it anyway because it is funny. That is exactly the type of meme Vlad wants on the Robinhood app.

It is sitting around 16 million right now. Put a meme like that on the Robinhood app in a bull run and a billion is not the ceiling, it is the floor of the conversation. Imagine it goes to 10 billion. Nothing is stopping it.

clips.hook: You are going to be lucky you endured this.
clips.caption:
The good news is that eventually, in the long run, people buy crypto again. They buy Bitcoin. They buy the meme coins. They buy the alts. They come onto the Robinhood chain, they learn how to swap, and maybe they stop needing exchanges as much.

So the long run outlook is good, and it is really good for anybody who is in crypto right now and has not checked out. We are in an economic expansion. We are just not feeling it yet. Eventually we start feeling it.

The bull run is going to start over again, and a lot of you are going to be lucky that you just tried to endure the pain we are seeing right now.

clips.hook: A freaking Inu did 3 billion. Watch this.
clips.caption:
Watch what happens when I drag this chart to the right.

Akita Inu. No Coinbase. No Binance. No centralized exchange of any kind. And the market cap runs all the way to 3 billion dollars.

I hovered over that candle three times because I did not believe it either. A freaking Inu, in a bull run, with none of the advantages everyone says a token needs. That happened once already. Keep that number in your head the next time somebody tells you a meme coin cannot get there.
